about_the_game:
Dive into Hole Digging Simulator, where every shovel swing unearths a new story! From carving WW1 trenches to escaping prison or hunting pirate treasure, this first-person digging adventure spans five thrilling campaigns. Upgrade your tools, craft epic gear, and conquer diverse scenarios—from medieval sieges to a mad dash to the planet’s core. Whether you’re strategizing, exploring, or just digging for fun, this addictive simulator delivers endless depth and discovery. Wishlist now and start digging your legacy!

Why You’ll Dig It

  • Epic Campaigns, Endless Stories: Live five unique adventures:

    • WW1 Soldier: Dig trenches to shield your squad in a gritty, historical fight.

    • Prison Break: Tunnel to freedom in a tense, high-stakes escape.

    • Medieval Siege: Burrow under castle walls to outsmart your enemies.

    • Crazy Scientist: Drill to the Earth’s core in a wild, sci-fi quest.

    • Pirate’s Bounty: Unearth treasure on a mysterious island full of secrets.

  • Satisfying Digging Mechanics: Feel every scoop in immersive first-person view, with responsive controls perfect for PC or controller (Steam Deck ready!).

  • Build Your Arsenal: Upgrade shovels, drills, and gear to dig faster and deeper. Craft unique tools to tackle each campaign’s challenges.

  • Dynamic Scenarios: Each campaign offers distinct goals—fortify, escape, infiltrate, or explore—ensuring no two digs feel the same.

  • Achievements & Replayability: Unlock rewards and master every scenario, from stealthy tunnels to massive excavations.

  • Cozy Yet Thrilling: Blend relaxing digging with gripping narratives, wrapped in vibrant, approachable visuals.

Join the Digging Revolution!
Crafted by passionate indie developers, Hole Digging Simulator transforms a simple spade into a gateway to adventure. With diverse campaigns and addictive progression, it’s the ultimate sandbox for strategists, explorers, and dreamers. Wishlist today and be the first to break ground on launch day!
